name: Oil & Gas
description: Upstream exploration and production, midstream transportation and storage, and downstream refining and distribution of crude oil and natural gas.

sub_industries.name: Upstream — Wellhead
sub_industries.description: Equipment at the wellhead assembly monitoring production from individual wells, including Christmas trees, chokes, and wellhead controllers.

device_types.name: Wellhead Controller
device_types.description: RTU or controller monitoring the wellhead assembly. Measures tubing and casing pressures, temperature, choke position, and production flow rate.

tags.name: Tubing Pressure
tags.description: Pressure in the production tubing string. Primary indicator of well productivity and drawdown.

tags.name: Casing Pressure
tags.description: Pressure in the annular space between tubing and casing. Indicates gas lift operation, casing gas production, or integrity issues.

tags.name: Wellhead Temperature
tags.description: Flowing wellhead temperature used for fluid property calculations and hydrate risk assessment.

tags.name: Choke Position
tags.description: Position of the production choke valve as a percentage of full open. Controls well flow rate.

tags.name: Flow Rate
tags.description: Gas production rate in thousand cubic feet per day at standard conditions.

tags.name: Run Status
tags.description: Well on/off production status.

device_types.name: Christmas Tree
device_types.description: The assembly of valves, spools, and fittings at the top of the wellbore. Monitors annulus pressure, wellhead pressure, and valve states.

tags.name: Annulus Pressure
tags.description: Pressure in the annular space between the production tubing and the casing string.

tags.name: Wellhead Pressure
tags.description: Flowing wellhead pressure at the top of the production tubing string.

tags.name: Master Valve Position
tags.description: Open/closed status of the master gate valve at the base of the Christmas tree.

sub_industries.name: Upstream — Tank Battery / Storage
sub_industries.description: Production storage and separation equipment at the lease level, including oil tanks, produced water tanks, separators, treaters, and gun barrels.

device_types.name: Oil Storage Tank
device_types.description: Atmospheric storage tank for produced crude oil awaiting transport. Monitored for level, temperature, and volume. Net volume is temperature-corrected to 60°F base conditions.

tags.name: Level
tags.description: Fluid level measured from the tank bottom. Raw measurement before strapping table conversion.

tags.name: Temperature
tags.description: Fluid temperature used for volume correction to 60°F base conditions (VCF calculation).

tags.name: Pressure
tags.description: Tank vapor space pressure. Typically near atmospheric for open-top tanks; monitored on vapor-recovery units.

tags.name: Net Volume
tags.description: Temperature-corrected net oil volume in barrels at 60°F base. Derived from level + strapping table + VCF.

tags.name: Gross Volume
tags.description: Total tank volume at observed temperature, before correction.

tags.name: Density (API Gravity)
tags.description: Crude oil API gravity used for VCF calculation and crude quality reporting.

device_types.name: Produced Water Tank
device_types.description: Storage tank for produced water (saltwater) separated from crude oil production. Monitored prior to disposal or reinjection.

tags.name: Level
tags.description: Fluid level in the produced water tank.

tags.name: Temperature
tags.description: Produced water temperature.

tags.name: Volume
tags.description: Calculated volume of produced water in barrels.

tags.name: Salinity
tags.description: Total dissolved solids in parts per million. Used for disposal well compatibility and regulatory reporting.

device_types.name: Three-Phase Separator
device_types.description: Pressure vessel that separates wellstream into gas, oil, and water phases. The primary production separation device at the tank battery.

tags.name: Inlet Pressure
tags.description: Wellstream pressure at the separator inlet.

tags.name: Outlet Pressure
tags.description: Gas outlet pressure. Controls backpressure on the wellstream.

tags.name: Operating Temperature
tags.description: Separator operating temperature affecting fluid viscosity and separation efficiency.

tags.name: Liquid Level
tags.description: Oil/water interface level inside the separator as a percentage of vessel height.

tags.name: Gas Rate
tags.description: Gas production rate leaving the separator in thousand cubic feet per day.

tags.name: Oil Rate
tags.description: Oil production rate leaving the separator in barrels per day.

device_types.name: Heater Treater
device_types.description: Fired vessel that heats the wellstream to break oil/water emulsions. Used when production contains tight emulsions that won't separate by gravity alone.

tags.name: Inlet Pressure
tags.description: Wellstream pressure at the treater inlet.

tags.name: Operating Temperature
tags.description: Treating temperature — typically 120–160°F for crude emulsions.

tags.name: Fire Tube Temperature
tags.description: Temperature at the fire tube surface. High temps indicate scale buildup or low liquid level.

tags.name: Water Boot Level
tags.description: Level in the water boot used to control water dump valve.

tags.name: Run Status
tags.description: Heater treater operational status — burner firing.

sub_industries.name: Upstream — Artificial Lift
sub_industries.description: Equipment used to increase fluid flow from wells that lack sufficient reservoir pressure to produce naturally, including rod pumps, ESPs, and gas lift systems.

device_types.name: Rod Pump (Pump Jack)
device_types.description: Surface-driven reciprocating pump that lifts fluid from the wellbore via a sucker rod string. The most common artificial lift method in onshore oil production.

tags.name: Strokes Per Minute
tags.description: Pumping speed in strokes per minute. Affects production rate and rod string fatigue.

tags.name: Motor Current
tags.description: Motor current draw. Abnormal patterns indicate pump-off, fluid pound, or mechanical issues.

tags.name: Motor Runtime
tags.description: Cumulative motor run hours for maintenance scheduling.

tags.name: Peak Upstroke Load
tags.description: Peak rod string load on the upstroke. Used for dynamometer card analysis.

tags.name: Peak Downstroke Load
tags.description: Peak rod string load on the downstroke.

tags.name: Run Status
tags.description: Pump on/off status.

device_types.name: ESP (Electric Submersible Pump)
device_types.description: Multi-stage centrifugal pump installed in the wellbore driven by a downhole electric motor. Used for high-volume liquid production.

tags.name: Pump Intake Pressure
tags.description: Pressure at the pump intake. Key indicator of drawdown and pump submergence.

tags.name: Pump Discharge Pressure
tags.description: Pressure at the pump discharge. Difference from intake indicates pump head generated.

tags.name: Motor Temperature
tags.description: Downhole motor winding temperature. High temps trigger shutdown to prevent motor failure.

tags.name: Motor Current
tags.description: Motor current draw at surface. Abnormal values indicate mechanical issues or gas interference.

tags.name: Drive Frequency
tags.description: VFD output frequency controlling pump speed. Typically 40–70 Hz.

tags.name: Run Status
tags.description: ESP operational status.

sub_industries.name: Midstream — Compressor Station
sub_industries.description: Facilities that compress natural gas for pipeline transportation or gas lift injection.

device_types.name: Reciprocating Compressor
device_types.description: Positive-displacement compressor using pistons driven by a crankshaft. Common in gathering systems and gas lift applications.

tags.name: Suction Pressure
tags.description: Gas pressure at the compressor inlet.

tags.name: Discharge Pressure
tags.description: Gas pressure at the compressor outlet.

tags.name: Engine RPM
tags.description: Engine or motor speed in revolutions per minute.

tags.name: Lube Oil Pressure
tags.description: Lubrication oil pressure. Low oil pressure triggers emergency shutdown.

tags.name: Cylinder Head Temp
tags.description: Temperature at the cylinder head. High temps indicate valve failure or excessive compression ratio.

tags.name: Vibration
tags.description: Overall vibration velocity. Trend monitoring detects bearing wear and mechanical imbalance.

tags.name: Run Hours
tags.description: Cumulative operating hours for PM scheduling.

tags.name: Load %
tags.description: Percentage of rated capacity at which the compressor is operating.

device_types.name: Centrifugal Compressor
device_types.description: Dynamic compressor that imparts velocity to gas via rotating impellers. Used in high-volume pipeline and processing applications.

tags.name: Suction Pressure
tags.description: Inlet gas pressure.

tags.name: Discharge Pressure
tags.description: Outlet gas pressure.

tags.name: Shaft RPM
tags.description: Compressor shaft speed. Off-design speed causes surge or choke.

tags.name: Bearing Temperature
tags.description: Journal bearing temperature. Rising temps indicate lubrication failure or alignment issues.

tags.name: Vibration
tags.description: Shaft vibration amplitude. Critical parameter for rotating machinery health.

tags.name: Power
tags.description: Shaft power consumption in kilowatts.

sub_industries.name: Midstream — Pipeline
sub_industries.description: Transmission and gathering pipelines transporting crude oil, natural gas, or NGLs.

device_types.name: Pipeline Segment Monitor
device_types.description: Monitoring point on a pipeline segment at block valve stations or taps. Measures pressure, flow, and temperature.

tags.name: Inlet Pressure
tags.description: Pipeline pressure at the upstream measurement point.

tags.name: Outlet Pressure
tags.description: Pipeline pressure at the downstream measurement point.

tags.name: Flow Rate
tags.description: Gas flow rate through the segment in thousand cubic feet per day.

tags.name: Gas Temperature
tags.description: Gas temperature. Affects density, compressibility, and hydrate formation risk.

sub_industries.name: Downstream — Metering / Fiscal
sub_industries.description: Custody transfer and fiscal metering equipment measuring the quantity and quality of hydrocarbons changing ownership.

device_types.name: Flow Computer
device_types.description: Electronic device that calculates corrected volumes from raw meter signals, pressure, and temperature. The official record for custody transfer.

tags.name: Flow Rate
tags.description: Instantaneous gas flow rate at standard conditions.

tags.name: Accumulated Volume
tags.description: Total accumulated gas volume at standard conditions since last reset.

tags.name: Static Pressure
tags.description: Line static pressure used for volume correction to standard conditions.

tags.name: Gas Temperature
tags.description: Gas temperature used for volume correction to standard conditions (60°F).

tags.name: Energy Content
tags.description: Heating value of the gas in BTU per cubic foot. Used to calculate energy (MMBTU) for billing.

tags.name: Meter Factor
tags.description: Correction factor from calibration. Values near 1.0 indicate a well-calibrated meter.
